eval_cases.description: Multi-turn evaluation: Turn 1 identifies top promo abuse offenders; Turn 2 pulls federated AWS S3 logs.

parts.text: Show cashiers with active cashier promo abuse alerts in the last 7 days.
Based on BigQuery pos_anomaly_alerts for the past 7 days, Cashier CASH_1190 at Store 48 has the highest promo override rate (42.5%) with 18 anomaly flags.
Retrieve the federated AWS S3 checkout transaction logs for CASH_1190 at Store 48 to inspect the applied promo codes.

eval_cases.description: Multi-turn evaluation: Turn 1 checks transaction line items; Turn 2 assesses warranty terms for the item.

parts.text: Transaction TXN-20260312-0015811 contains 1x Oppo Enco Air 2 Pro Bluetooth Wireless Earbuds ($43.99) and 1x Apple Watch Magnetic Charging Cable ($36.99).
Is the Oppo Enco Air 2 Pro covered under our standard return and warranty policy if it was purchased 45 days ago?

eval_cases.description: Multi-turn evaluation: Intent switching from POS printer error recovery to store on-hand inventory position.

parts.text: The POS printer at station 2 is showing error ERR-DN-PRNT-24V. What should the cashier do?
For ERR-DN-PRNT-24V on Diebold Nixdorf printers: Turn off printer power, release the green cutter lever manually to unjam receipt paper, check 24V cable seating, and power on.
Now check if Store 48 has replacement receipt paper rolls in on-hand inventory.
